name: codex-markdone
description: Local-first Codex Desktop reader with selection-aware Markdown and Word equation copying.

interface.shortDescription: Select and copy Codex output, lines, or equations.
interface.longDescription: Open Codex Desktop or CLI transcripts in a local reader, copy selections as Obsidian Markdown, and paste equations into Word as editable MathML/Office Math.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the Codex MarkDone reader for a local Codex transcript.
